configure.title: Ilayisensi
configure.description: Inqanaba lelayisensi yokusetyenziswa kwe-AI kulo msebenzi. Jonga https://dmd-program.github.io/aiul/ ukufumana iinkcukacha.

configure.title: Isiguquli semidiya
configure.description: Isiguquli sommandla wemidiya esingenyanzelekanga. Sichaza uhlobo lwemidiya esebenza kulo le layisensi.

configure.title: I-URI ye-AIUL (OER Schema)
configure.description: OER Schema: I-URI yephepha lesalathiso seLayisensi yokusetyenziswa kwe-AI. Izaliswa ngokuzenzekelayo ukusuka kwikhonkco lelayisensi xa ingasetwanga.
